content:
Evidence from the datasheet groups receiver specs by **OC-3** (Notes 15a/16a/19, 155.52 MBd, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹⁰) vs **FE** (Notes 15b/16b/19, 125 MBd, BER ≤ 2.5×10⁻¹⁰). Transmitter optical and electrical specs are shared across those applications; **HFBR-5961LZ/GZ** vs **HFBR-5961ALZ/AGZ** differ only in temperature (not in the optical table rows). Per your rule, each part number is its own mode, paired with each application row. **Signal detect deassert** is one table row (−45 dBm) for all. **Center wavelength** typical **1308 nm** is from the transmitter optical table; **1300 nm** is ordering/marketing only. **Power dissipation** values in the pool are TX (0.4 / 0.64 W) vs RX (0.225 / 0.44 W) rows—not per application—so each mode uses TX typical **0.4 W** (same transmitter section as the shared LED). **Tx minimum power** **−22.5 dBm** is from the general transmitter minimum row (application- and model-independent). No mode-specific penalties appear in the input. **0.025 Gbaud** is a measurement condition (25 MBd), not a separate receiver application row—no mode for it.
